messages:
sophie: Quick bench ask — can someone run a tail-latency onboarding sweep for mantis-13b-longctx (32k context)? Need p50/p95/p99/p999, KVCACHE hit rates, and memory eviction counts across fp16 + q4 variants. Use 200 concurrent streams of 512 tokens, 1k warmup, measure 30m steady-state.

sophie: Use the standard bench runner and tag results with commit + model-recipe. Example command:
```bash
./bench_runner --model mantis-13b-longctx --ctx 32768 --streams 200 --seq 512 --warmup 1000 --duration 1800 --variants fp16,q4_0 --tag mantis-longctx-onboard/1742510001
```

benchbot: queued job #4571 (mantis-longctx-onboard/1742510001). Estimated runtime ~45m. Runner: bench-queue.

thomas: I can pick this up. I'll enable prefix/KV caching (policy = longctx-default-v1) and collect per-request profiler traces + perf events.

kai: Can we also run a baseline (atlas-13b-v1) with the same workload so we have delta on p99 and tokens/s? Also capture GPU util + stall reasons.

sophie: Yes please add baseline atlas-13b-v1. Keep the same seed and workload. Tag results with the ticket id.

benchbot: job #4571 started on pool gs-rt-32g-8x. Logs: /runs/4571/logs.txt (streaming).

thomas: Preliminary after warmup (first 100k tokens):
- mantis fp16: p50 24ms, p95 82ms, p99 120ms, p999 360ms
- mantis q4_0: p50 26ms, p95 95ms, p99 160ms, p999 520ms
KVCACHE hit: 68% steady-state. Evictions: ~0.3% of requests (TTL-driven).

kai: Those p999s are concerning. Are spikes correlated to attention windows >16k or to cache thrashing? Can you dump latency buckets per input-length and perf event counters?

thomas: Uploading quick snapshot CSV -> /s3/rw-inference/bench/mantis-13b-longctx/1742510001/quick_snapshot.csv (contains per-seq buckets, gpu_util, stall_reasons).

nina: I pushed a small runtime tweak (kvcache_max_entries=1_200_000) and re-ran q4_0 for a short sweep. New q4_0 p999 improved to ~430ms. Results in same S3 folder.

sophie: Nice! Can someone draft a short publish note for the onboarding doc summarizing key metrics + recommended runtime config (enable prefix cache, bump kvcache entries, prefer fp16 for lowest tail latency but q4 OK with the kvcache bump)? I'll add it to the model catalog entry.

thomas: I'll draft the note and generate perf plots. Action items: (1) Publish CSV + perf plots (thomas), (2) Add recommended runtime config to model recipe (nina), (3) Schedule staging canary with traffic caps to validate in-situ (kai).

sophie: Thanks — tagging @runtime-oncall for canary window. :clap:

runtime-oncall: Canary slot booked tomorrow 01:00-03:00 UTC. I'll watch tail latencies and GPUErr rates.

benchbot: job #4571 completed. Results uploaded: /s3/rw-inference/bench/mantis-13b-longctx/1742510001/results.json

nina: PR open -> https://repo.redwood.ai/model-recipes/pulls/1324 (adds kvcache tweak + quant fallback policy).

sophie: Perfect — I'll close the onboarding ticket after PR merge and canary. :white_check_mark:
